pages.name: Warm Glow
pages.description: A glowing fruit hangs deep in the hollow. The thin roots around it move slowly.

options.description: Pluck the fruit in one motion

pages.name: Forest Lantern
pages.description: The roots part, and the fruit becomes a little lantern filled with living golden light.

scenePatch.description: The hollow is empty, but a soft golden glow remains in the wood.

pages.name: Extinguished Fruit
pages.description: The roots snap shut; the fruit falls and immediately goes dark.
